task_context.problem_statement: A developer was buying land. He bought 4 acres at $1,863 per acre. He then split the land he purchased into 9 lots. How much should he sell each lot for just to break even?
task_context.reference_solution:
His purchase cost is 4 acres * $1863 = $<<4*1863=7452>>7452.
He divided the land into 9 plots, so the price per lot would be $7452 / 9 = $<<7452/9=828>>828.
#### 828
